title: Anacapa Island Rescue
description: A Coast Guard Station Channel Islands Harbor boatcrew and a rescue swimmer from Coast Guard Air Station San Francisco Forward Operating Base Point Mugu assist three people from the water after their vessel capsized near Anacapa Island, California, June 22, 2018. The three people in the water were transported to Station Channel Islands were emergency medical services awaited. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Jesse Kassbaum)
